reachability_signal: Before binary exits with code 2 (hang) or timeout; After binary exits with code 0 (ok) and prints 'RESULT: ok (fixed behavior)'
expected_signal: After binary exits with code 0 and prints status=200 within 1 second; Before binary hangs and times out after 5+ seconds
input_strategy: HTTP POST request with Expect: 100-continue header sent to server handler that writes 200 without sending 100 Continue. Tests both normal path (response succeeds) and error path (hang detection via timeout).
limitations: Requires Go 1.24+ (unpatched) and Go 1.27-devel (patched) toolchains. Building patched Go from source requires Go 1.24+ bootstrap. The test uses a synthetic HTTP client-server harness rather than the project-native test framework.
